app.emptyTagline: ACP desktop client · manage coding-agent conversations anchored on project directories
app.emptyHint: ← Add a project directory on the left to start

closeTab.title: Chat is still generating
closeTab.body: "{{title}}" is still generating. Closing the tab won't stop the turn on its own.

sidebar.noProjects: No projects yet. Click + above to add a code directory.
sidebar.popoutTip: Open in separate window · click to focus

newSession.title: New session
newSession.existingDesc: Run in the project directory or an already-created worktree. Multiple chats can share one directory (e.g. two agents reviewing).
newSession.existingNoteMain: Runs in the project's main directory.
newSession.existingNoteGuest: Joins the existing worktree on {{branch}} (guest — shares it with its owner).
newSession.existingNoteNone: Pick a directory: the project main, or an existing worktree.
newSession.worktreeDesc: Create a dedicated git worktree and branch for this session; sessions don't interfere, and changes can be merged back into the base branch.
newSession.baseRefTip: The new branch grows from this base, and merges back into it (checkout-from = merge-back-to).
newSession.baseRefNote: New branch md/<id> will be based on {{branch}}; merge goes back to {{branch}}.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.desc: Pick which to connect for this session. Changes need a new session (MCP is fixed at session start).

capability.probeFailedTip: Probing this harness errored; capability bits may be inaccurate
capability.embeddedContextTip: Can embed files / resources as context in a message
capability.modelTip: Can switch models within a session
capability.modeTip: Can switch run mode within a session (e.g. plan / code)

chat.dropHint: Project files become @mentions (or inline images); files outside the project are attached by path
chat.continueSessionTip: Start the agent and resume this session

error.harness_reconnect_failed: Auto-reconnect failed. Send a message to retry manually.
error.agent_turn_incomplete: The agent didn't finish this turn normally (often: the selected model is unavailable, refused, or a limit was hit). The connection is fine — retry, or switch the model and resend.

notice.harness_empty_turn: This command produced no further output. Connection is fine — keep going.

selectionToolbar.label: Selection actions
selectionToolbar.quoteTip: Insert the selected text as a quote into the composer
selectionToolbar.quoteToChatTip: Insert the selected text as a quote into the chat composer

composer.placeholderQueued: Queue next message… (Enter to enqueue · auto-sent after this turn)
composer.historyHintTip: Use arrow keys to browse past messages of this session; edit or press Enter to resend
composer.historyBadgeTip: ↑ older · ↓ newer · past latest restores draft
composer.branchTip: Current git branch · click to start a new chat from here
composer.pasteSnippetTip: Pasted snippet ({{lines}} lines) · click to preview, full text is included when sent
composer.addImageTip: Add image (sent as ACP Image block · paste also works)
composer.addAudioTip: Add audio (sent as ACP Audio block)
composer.slashUnknownHint: The current agent doesn't recognize it; sending as-is may error or be silently ignored.
composer.sendAsPlainTip: Prepend a space to bypass command parsing and send as a normal message
composer.enqueueTip: Enqueue · ⌘⇧Enter (always queues; auto-sent after current turn)
composer.switchCostHint: Current context ~{{tokens}} tokens · estimated per-turn cost shown per model (token-only if unpriced)

mention.goUpTip: Go to parent directory (Backspace on empty query also works)

queue.title: Queued · {{count}}
queue.hint: Auto-sent in order after this turn
queue.interruptTip: Send now: interrupts current generation, sends this first (rest stay queued)
queue.revokeTip: Revoke: removes from queue and refills the composer for editing
queue.editTip: Edit: rename this queued message in place (keeps its place in queue)
queue.scheduleTip: Schedule: pick a time to auto-send this message (skipped until then)
queue.clearScheduleTip: Clear schedule: send as soon as possible (next drain)
queue.scheduledSendTip: Scheduled send — will be sent after this time
queue.scheduleExpired: The picked time has already passed. Please pick a future time.
queue.hasScheduled: Some messages are scheduled to send later

terminal.empty: Click + or empty area to create a terminal

gitPanel.title: Source Control
gitPanel.commitPlaceholderBusy: Chat in progress, commit after it ends…
gitPanel.commitPlaceholder: Commit message (Cmd / Ctrl + Enter to commit)
gitPanel.aiCommitTip: Let this session's AI review changes, generate a commit message, and commit
gitPanel.mergeTipBase: Merge this session's branch back into {{branch}} (its base). Only committed changes are merged; uncommitted changes stay in the worktree.
gitPanel.mergeTipLegacy: Merge this session's branch into the main repo's current HEAD (legacy session without explicit base).
gitPanel.mergeNothingTip: No commits ahead of the base branch. Commit your changes first, or this session is already merged.
gitPanel.mergeGuestTip: You're a guest in this worktree (entered an existing directory) — merge is unavailable. Only the worktree's owner can merge.

deleteWt.title: Delete this worktree?
deleteWt.body: {{count}} other conversation(s) still use this worktree. Deleting it affects them.

general.versionDesc: Current app version (injected from git tag on release builds)

language.desc: Switch the UI language, takes effect immediately.

appearance.fontScaleDesc: Scales the font size of primary reading areas (conversations, composer, titles). Auxiliary elements (badges, timestamps) stay fixed to preserve information density.

sound.notifyDesc: Play a short chime when an agent turn ends naturally (on by default).

conversation.memorySaverDesc: Clear a conversation's cache when you switch away from it to reduce memory use; reload from local on return (on by default). Off keeps every opened conversation cached — faster switching but memory grows with session count.

empty.appearance: No appearance settings yet; they will be added here later.
empty.conversation: No conversation settings yet; they will be added here later.

remote.desc: Embed a token-authenticated HTTP server in the desktop process: browsers / mobile devices on the same Wi-Fi can connect to this app directly — full chat history, messaging and permission prompts, live alongside the desktop UI.
remote.title: Enable remote access
remote.toggleTip: Devices on your LAN can access this app via a token-protected link
remote.statusEnabledNotRunning: Enabled but not running (startup failed; check logs)
remote.portDesc: Listen port (1-65535). Applying while running restarts the listener; connected devices reconnect within ~1s.
remote.tokenDesc: Devices exchange this token for a credential on first connect; regenerating invalidates existing sessions immediately.
remote.urlsDesc: Open any of these in a browser on your phone / another device (one-time exchange, no re-entry afterwards).
remote.notAttached: Embedded remote is unavailable in this build (server mode).

perm.desc: Rules route each tool request before asking: allow auto-approves, deny auto-rejects, ask prompts. First match wins; empty field = wildcard.
perm.resetTip: Restore the built-in default rules (replaces your custom rules)

mcp.desc: MCP servers registered globally. Pick which to connect per session in the new-chat dialog. Stored locally (SQLite); import an opencode / OMP config to bulk-add.
mcp.importDesc: Paste an opencode ("mcp" key) or OMP (".mcp.json" / "mcpServers") config — format is auto-detected. Existing names are skipped. OAuth/auth fields can't be carried over ACP and are dropped.
mcp.defaultOnTip: Pre-checked when starting a new session

harness.desc: Auto-discovered ACP harnesses installed on this machine. Versions are detected locally and checked against their upstream release.
harness.refreshTip: Re-scan PATH and re-check upstream releases
harness.upgradeTip: Run this harness's own upgrade command to fetch the latest version
harness.autoCheckDesc: Periodically re-scan and check upstream releases while running; show a red dot on the settings entry and harness menu when a newer version is found (on by default).
harness.autoUpgradeDesc: When an upgrade is found, silently run each harness's own install script in the background (off by default). Skips harnesses with a running session; failed upgrades cool down for an hour.
harness.autoUpgradeRiskTip: Risky: this runs each harness's official install script unattended (network, disk writes, may restart services or change your environment). Enable only if you trust the upstream installers.
harness.addBtnTip: Manually add an ACP-capable harness (ID / name / start command)
harness.addDesc: Add an ACP-capable coding agent. Provide its stdio ACP start command, run "Self-check" to verify the ACP contract, then add.
harness.addCmdTip: stdio ACP start command, arguments separated by spaces. The first token is the executable to run (used by the process reaper). e.g. junie acp / /usr/local/bin/goose --stdio acp
harness.addErrIdConflict: This ID already exists; choose another
harness.addErrNameEmpty: Display name must not be empty
harness.addErrCmdEmpty: Start command must not be empty
harness.addNeedProbe: Run "Self-check" above and pass before adding
harness.editDesc: Change display name or start command. The ID cannot change (sessions pin to it); re-run self-check after editing the command.
harness.editTip: Edit display name / start command (only user-added harnesses)
harness.probeTip: Re-run the ACP conformance self-check on this harness
